claim: On July 15, 2025 Amazon ECS added native blue/green deployments, which let you validate new service revisions before directing production traffic to them.
question: When did ECS add native blue/green deployments, and do they still need CodeDeploy?
note: Older questions may assume that ECS blue/green needs AWS CodeDeploy (CodeDeploy blue/green since 2018-11-27).
